newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai rubber prices ease this week.
newsitem.headline: Thai rubber prices ease this week.

text.p: Thai rubber prices eased slightly this week in a market packed with sellers and few buyers, trade sources said.
Thai benchmark RSS3 for October shipment was quoted around US$1.25 a kg this week, compared with $1.26-1.29 last week.
Latex dipped and was quoted at around $0.99/kg from $1.02 last week.

High stocks in Japan and rising supply continued to pressure the market, the sources said. According to sources at the rubber auction market, the amount of rubber entering the market this week rose by about 24 percent.-- Bangkok newsroom (662) 652-0642
